# Subprocessor Governance

## Purpose

Address risk introduced when a supplier relies on additional parties to deliver a material service or process information.

## Expectations

Where risk warrants it, supplier agreements and due diligence SHOULD address subprocessor transparency, applicable security/privacy obligations, material change notification, incident cooperation, data-location considerations, and downstream deletion or return obligations.

## Risk depth

Not every low-risk commodity dependency requires detailed subprocessor review. Depth should follow data access, privilege, business criticality, and regulatory context.

## Change

A material subprocessor change may trigger renewed supplier, privacy, security, or concentration-risk review.
